name: See3CAM_CU30_CHL_TC
notes: TC is the USB Type-C version of the CU30 board: a two-board USB 3 camera with an S-mount lens holder.
Has an ISP (auto exposure, auto white balance and related processing). For synthetic imagery, decide whether to model the raw sensor or the post-ISP output.
